content.text:
I couldn't find a single-parameter fix for flange_v1. The baseline safety factor is 0.212 under the default 8000 N load in -Z on `face_mating`, with peak stress of 848.5 MPa against a 180 MPa yield. Nothing was saved, and the part is back at its original values.

I probed each parameter at its most favorable allowed value:

| Parameter | Value tried | SF |
|---|---|---|
| `thickness_mm` | 5 (sheet stock maximum) | 0.839 |
| `fillet_radius_mm` | 6 | 0.212 (no effect) |
| `hole_diameter_mm` | 4 (M4 bolt minimum) | 0.354 |

Thickness helped most but is capped at 5.0 mm, so none of the three can reach 2.0 on its own. The peak stress was at node 4218 on `face_mounting` in every solve. This is the latest revision of the part.

Reaching SF 2.0 would take a combination of changes or a lower load. Only one parameter may be changed under the rules, so I didn't try that.
